{{Field procedure|summary=Turn collected fragments into cargo by managing refinery bins and transferring completed tonnes into the cargo hold.}}

Use this procedure when collected fragments are not becoming cargo, the refinery is filling with unwanted resources, or a mining run needs a clean refinery workflow.

{{Draft warning}}

== Required equipment ==

* [[Refinery]]
* Cargo space
* Collectible mining fragments or chunks

== Procedure ==

{{Procedure steps|
# Confirm the refinery is installed, powered, and not disabled by module priorities.
# Confirm the cargo hold has free space for completed tonnes.
# Let collector limpets deliver fragments to the refinery.
# Watch refinery bins as each resource percentage rises toward a full tonne.
# If a bin contains an unwanted resource, vent or clear that bin before it blocks preferred fragments.
# If collectors keep bringing unwanted fragments, add that commodity to the ignore workflow for the run.
# When a tonne completes, confirm it transfers into cargo and frees refinery space.
}}

== Completion check ==

The refinery is working when useful fragments are increasing bin percentages, completed tonnes are moving into cargo, and unwanted bins are not blocking the desired commodity.

== Common problems ==

* '''Refinery full:''' clear unwanted bins or free cargo space.
* '''Cargo full:''' sell, transfer, abandon, or make space before more tonnes can complete.
* '''Wrong fragments keep arriving:''' see [[How to Ignore Unwanted Mining Commodities]].
